request.title: Nordholz cannot deliver pine beams
request.instructions: Nordholz just told us that they cannot deliver any pine beams before 2026-11-30 (kiln damage), including the two open purchase orders. Our beam stock will not last. Find out how bad it is, secure alternative supply and make sure frame production keeps running. Ask Cora to re-plan production if the new supply does not close the gap, and Horst to take care of customers whose delivery promise is at risk.

tasks.plan:
# Goal
Secure replacement supply for `BEAM-PINE-80` after Nordholz's delivery stop, so frame production keeps running and the current material shortage is removed. The live ERP shows the shortage starts on `2026-10-15`, `13` late orders, and `1260` sofas late.

# Inputs
- ERP overview (`2026-10-05`): `lateOrders=13`, `sofasLate=1260`, `lateOrdersCustomerNotInformed=13`, `materialShortages.BEAM-PINE-80=production held back from 2026-10-15`.
- Inventory: `5200` usable `BEAM-PINE-80` on hand.
- Open Nordholz purchase orders: `PO-4411` for `8000` pcs due `2026-11-30` and `PO-4418` for `7000` pcs due `2026-12-14`, both delayed because Nordholz cannot deliver before `2026-11-30`.
- BOM facts: `LUND` uses `6` beams, `OSLO` uses `8`, `BERGEN` uses `12`.
- Supplier options for `BEAM-PINE-80`: `S-BALTIC` lead `6` workdays, min `1000`, max `6000`, express available (`4` workdays, `+0.3`/unit); `S-SILESIA` lead `10` workdays, min `500`, max `3000`, no express; Nordholz is unavailable.
- What-if result: `create_purchase_order` for `S-BALTIC` `6000` pcs express plus `S-SILESIA` `3000` pcs standard changes KPI from `lateOrders=13`, `sofasLate=1260`, `lateWithoutCustomerNotice=13`, `materialShortages={BEAM-PINE-80}` to `lateOrders=0`, `sofasLate=0`, `lateWithoutCustomerNotice=0`, `materialShortages={}`, at `costOfMeasuresEur=42450`.

# Steps
1. Create purchase order `create_purchase_order` for `supplierId=S-BALTIC`, `sku=BEAM-PINE-80`, `quantity=6000`, `express=true`, `note="Bridge pine beam shortage caused by Nordholz delay until 2026-11-30"`.
2. Create purchase order `create_purchase_order` for `supplierId=S-SILESIA`, `sku=BEAM-PINE-80`, `quantity=3000`, `note="Bridge pine beam shortage caused by Nordholz delay until 2026-11-30"`.
3. Do not delegate to Cora or Horst in this run, because the simulated procurement package removes the beam shortage and clears the late-order KPI; only if execution diverges will follow-up work be needed.

# Outputs
- New purchase orders in ERP with the supplier, quantity, ETA and cost recorded at:
  - `PO-` ids returned by the two `create_purchase_order` calls.
- Updated ERP KPI expected after execution: `lateOrders=0`, `sofasLate=0`, `lateOrdersCustomerNotInformed=0`, `materialShortages={}`, `costOfMeasuresEur=42450`.
- Report file: `.agent/summaries/task-01M61ERCRH2T2GCCTCKNAWE1MC_plan_1.md`.

# Risks and open questions
- The plan assumes the live ERP still accepts both suppliers at the simulated lead times and quantities; if either order fails, the shortage may remain and a replanning step may be required.
- The delayed Nordholz POs stay open in this plan; cancel them only if execution or later planning makes that necessary.
- Wiki: company wiki `index.md`, `protocols/handoffs.md`, `protocols/ordered-delegation.md`, `rules/customer-notices.md`, `suppliers/overview.md` were read and used for the request format, dependency ordering, customer-notice rule, and supplier constraints.
